newsitem.title: USA: Star Banc named depository for funds.
newsitem.headline: Star Banc named depository for funds.

text.p: Star Bank NA, a unit of Star Banc Corp, said on Monday it became the official custodial and depository bank for the Police and Firemen's Disability and Pension Fund for the State of Ohio.

In addition to the Police and Firemen's Disability and Pension Fund, Star Bank will also continue to serve as the custodial and depository bank for the State Highway Patrol Retirement System, the company said in a statement.

The Police and Firemen's Disability and Pension Fund and the State Highway Patrol Retirement System have a combined average balance of more than $6.5 billion in assets under custodial management, Star Bank said.
